scope: measurement uncertainty, correlated engineering priors, locked validation infrastructure

references.source: Louie A et al. Anesthesiology. 2018;128(3):520-530. PMID 29200008.
references.anchor: Stationary-control pulse oximetry RMSE was about 1.8 percentage points; motion and low perfusion increased errors, often above 3 percentage points.
references.model_use: v0.20 uses 1.8 percentage-point Gaussian SD as a baseline engineering SpO2 measurement noise. This is not a commercial-device accuracy claim.

references.source: Sediame S et al. Accuracy of the i-STAT bedside blood gas analyser. PMID 10489854.
references.anchor: Bedside pH and PaCO2 measurements were reported close to a laboratory reference analyzer, with non-zero analytical imprecision.
references.model_use: v0.20 adds finite pH/PaCO2/PaO2 measurement noise rather than exposing mechanistic truth.

references.source: Mitchell K et al. Comparison of time taken to obtain an arterial blood gas result using the Proxima point of care system versus a standard arterial blood gas sampling system. 2022. PMCID PMC9125450.
references.anchor: Mean result time was 6 min 31 s for standard ABG sampling versus 4 min 56 s for the in-line system.
references.model_use: v0.20 default ABG result delay is 7 min with 30-min research sampling cadence.

references.source: Chumlea WC et al. Total body water reference values and prediction equations for adults. Kidney Int. 2001. PMID 11380828.
references.anchor: TBW prediction depends on multiple body-size/demographic variables rather than an independent uniform fraction alone.
references.model_use: Supports replacing independent virtual-patient sampling with an explicitly correlated engineering prior.

references.source: Falz R et al. Normal Values of Hemoglobin Mass and Blood Volume in Young, Active Women and Men. Int J Sports Med. 2019. PMID 30791081.
references.anchor: Hemoglobin mass and blood volume vary with sex/body composition and lean body mass.
references.model_use: Supports avoiding fully independent blood-volume/Hb priors.

references.source: Dooley MJ et al. Poor correlation between body surface area and glomerular filtration rate. Cancer Chemother Pharmacol. 2000. PMID 11138467.
references.anchor: Reported correlation between actual-weight BSA and measured GFR was weak (r about 0.24).
references.model_use: v0.20 therefore uses only a modest body-weight/GFR rank correlation, not deterministic body-size scaling.

references.source: FDA. Assessing the Credibility of Computational Modeling and Simulation in Medical Device Submissions. Final Guidance, November 2023.
references.anchor: Risk-informed credibility assessment separates verification, validation, applicability and context of use.
references.model_use: v0.20 labels internal gates as credibility/verification checks and keeps locked external validation distinct.

correlated_prior_status: engineering rank-correlation prior; not a fitted human population covariance model
